verdict.rationale: Shortwave sits on top of Gmail's APIs rather than holding its own mail store, and one user reported that deleting the Shortwave account made switching back to Gmail low-risk. That suggests easy exit for email data, though no export from Shortwave itself is documented. missing for 10: any documented export of Shortwave-specific data (team comments, AI Snippets, AI filters, splits, todos), open-format export documentation, a public API/OpenAPI spec (probes 404), first-party offboarding docs.
